captionBasis: JDF 681's captions are the AcroForm field names Colorado authored plus the printed section. JDF 680 has no fields at all: each of its blanks is the printed RULE the value sits on, measured from the page's own content stream by scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-pdf-rule-lines.mjs and re-measured on every build. Both forms interleave their glyph runs, so the text extracted at each coordinate is recorded beside the blank rather than used as a check.
